The primary amine reacts with benzaldehyde to form an imine/iminium intermediate, which is reduced to the secondary amine:

**N-benzyl-1-aminocyclopropan-1-ylmethanol**  
also describable as **[(1-benzylamino)cyclopropyl]methanol**

The alcohol remains unchanged, while the original `–NH2` group becomes `–NHCH2Ph`.
